messages.title: The +7 scale mail of Ulaits {Death, Harm rC+ Will+}.
messages.body:
<lightgrey>

A leather suit covered with metal plates attached to each other in overlapping rows to provide full protection, but at the cost of reduced freedom of movement. 

Base armour rating: 6       Encumbrance rating: 10

<lightcyan>Death<lightgrey>:     It empowers your Necromancy spells and improves their success rate.
           When you cast a Necromancy spell, it may drain the life force of
           susceptible adjacent enemies to heal you; the chance and power of
           this effect depend on the spell's level.
Harm:      It increases damage dealt and taken.
rC+:       It protects you from cold.
Will+:     It increases your willpower.

It cannot be enchanted further.

This armour is completely useless to you: that is too small for you to equip!

This ancient artefact cannot be changed by magic or mundane means.

Stash search prefixes: {artefact} {artifact} {Death} {body armour} {body armor}
Menu/colouring prefixes: identified useless_item artefact armour
_________________

<darkgrey>“Nought can Deform the Human race
 Like to the Armours iron brace”
    -William Blake, “Auguries of Innocence”, 99-100. 1803.
